_comment: Carcass Front — the starter set and supplement, published as a GitHub
release on this repository. Fetch with: npm run rules:carcass
Same convention as data-sources/rulebook/SOURCES.json: the extracted text
under extracted/ IS committed and is what the pipeline reads, and a PDF
over ~5 MB is gitignored and fetched from the release instead.
Every asset records the sha256 of the file this repository was built
against. A download that does not match is refused: a source that is not
the source we verified against is worse than no source.

release.name: Carcass Front
release.note: Assets are fetched through the authenticated api.github.com asset endpoint by id.

assets.role: The supplement. Two Faction Lists with four Warband Variants, a Mercenary, five scenarios, the terrain piece rules, a random scenario generator, new Patrons, two campaigns and the Carcass Front Exploration Tables.
assets.note: The single-page edition, not the spread-page one: spreads interleave two pages of columns into one extraction pass and the text comes out shuffled.

assets.role: Introductory rules for the starter set. A cut-down restatement of the core rules rather than new content — held for cross-checking, not parsed.
The quickstart scenario that ships with the starter set.
The introductory Heretic Naval Raiders roster: a fixed starter list, not a faction list. The full entries are in the book.
The introductory Procession of the Sacred Affliction roster. As above.
The Vision Cards used in the Carcass Front Campaign, as printable cards.
The printable Campaign Tracker sheet. Image-only — it extracts to nothing, and is held for completeness rather than parsed.

The fold-out campaign map. Page 1 is the Carcass Front Zones table (33 zones, their Resources and the scenario played there), the Special Zone Outpost Bonuses, and the Carcass Front Scenario Generator charts. Page 2 is the zone board itself, which is a graphic and extracts to nothing.
assets.note: Recorded in _notAdded as print material with no rules content until Sep 2026. That was wrong: three tables the book's own campaign rules point at are printed here and nowhere else.

_notAdded: Two release assets are print material with no rules content and are not
